payload.gap_claim:
Positioned against the scanned field of ways to run isolated iterations:
- Raw git worktrees/branches by hand: isolation without process - no auto provision/merge/suspect, no local machine. Sheds process integration.
- i5's shipped lane (opt-in): the mechanism exists but is off-by-default and unproven-live. Sheds actual use.
- Parallel agent-harness sessions: throughput without honest merge - textual resolution silently wins. Sheds merge honesty.
- A shared-template machine only: one process for all, no per-iteration trim. Sheds local adaptation.
Ours - default provisioning + proven-live routing + a local trimmable machine + honest suspect-merge - is the only option that keeps all four.
payload.why_now: i5 already built the lane primitives (provision, ship-merge with suspects, adopt, retire) and the never-nest guard; the machine compiler already supports variants (systematic/lean/tutorial) and iteration-local SUB-machines (loadIterationMachine reads spec/iterations/<it>/machines/). So the gap closes by WIRING, not new invention: default the provisioning, span openInstance across the worktree homes, and lift the iteration-local machine from sub-machines to the top-level. Plus the owner has now ruled the default and OK'd the local-machine machinery.
payload.value_props:
One primary audience - the owner (and future parallel agents) - one one-pager:

Audience: the owner opening iterations, promised isolation.
Alternative today: i5's opt-in lane, off and unproven; everything runs on trunk.
Difference: isolation by default, proven live, with a trimmable local machine.
Validation signal: an iteration opens, runs, gates and ships entirely inside its own worktree, live.

Needs (need | outcome | pass line):
- Isolated by default | open an iteration, it lands in .worktrees/<id> on iter/<id>, trunk untouched | TEST: se_loop_start with NO flag provisions tree+branch; trunk HEAD unchanged.
- The live server drives it in its tree | se_loop_next/submit/gate operate on the worktree instance after start | LIVE END-TO-END TEST: open -> walk -> bless a gate -> ship, all through the real tool surface, instance resident in the worktree; unit-green is NOT acceptance.
- Trim its own machine | seed systematic locally, remove states, the walk follows the trimmed set | TEST: a local trimmed machine compiles + validates (no dangling edges) and the loop serves the trimmed states for that iteration only.
- Ship honestly | merge to trunk marks overlapping ledger nodes suspect | TEST (i5's, re-run live): the second ship marks suspects; the owner pushes.
payload.business_case: Skipped with reason: no external acquirer - i5b is internal tooling for the owner's own use of se. The currency is the owner's throughput (parallel, isolated iterations) and closing the shipped-off/untested regression - already captured in the value-prop pass lines.
